coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary recall search, not authoritative nationwide production collection.

Twelve targeted searches completed across sole/last/full-service grocery loss, disaster-related emergency distribution cancellation, abrupt pantry or food-bank service loss, and official SNAP/WIC/EBT immediate interruptions; no web search errors.
No new verified U.S. qualifying event was located in the observation window. Search-index latency and publication timestamps limit coverage.

Excluded unrelated, older, routine, or nonqualifying results: October 20 Wyandanch NY soup-kitchen fire story was published at 01:35 EDT, before the watch window; October 20 Laurel MS pantry reopening was published at 17:11 CDT, before the window and describes restored service; Wheatsville Austin closure was announced earlier and does not eliminate the only community grocery store; San Jose CA Safeway closure has no evidence it is the sole/full-service grocer; October 2025 SNAP shutdown articles were stale.
No approvals, publication, schedule changes, or primary collector alterations.
